beats.summary: Michael is worried about the escalating negative publicity about Dunder Mifflin and insists on making apology videos.

evidence.snippet: Michael: We gotta do something. This is spinning out of control, Pam.
Michael: No, then Newsweek picks it up. And then CNN does a story about it. Then… YouTube gets a hold of it…

beats.summary: Michael records apology videos with Pam running the camera and Dwight assisting with his hair.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Michael likes me to run the camera when he makes his apology videos. He says he needs a woman's touch.

beats.summary: Dwight humorously imitates Jim's mannerisms and face, confusing Karen and Jim.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (walks in dressed as Jim): Pam.

beats.summary: Kelly and Ryan repeatedly apologize to customers, showing the customer service team's response to the crisis.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: Oh my God, I am so sorry, that is so messed up. Everyone here is so upset, you have no idea.

beats.summary: Creed organizes a farewell card and collection for Debbie Brown, who was fired because of Dwight.
